method.container: Read-only pinned V1.0 chunk scan; each chunk is an 8-byte little-endian payload length followed by payload.
method.owner_links: Memory CVAMEMV1, Entity CVAENTV1, Relationship CVARELV1, Graph CVAGVER1, and Archive CVAAREC1 each carry global u64, owner-local u64, and 16-byte ObjectRef. Compact Memory/Entity/Relationship carriers inline their clocks; Ego carries only Ego-local sequence and has no global ticket or ObjectRef; compact Graph ordinal frames carry no clocks or references.
method.size_accounting: Payload field bytes are separated from per-chunk 8-byte Container framing. This is measurement only and assumes no replacement format or savings.
method.unknown_families: Recognized ticket/link/local-carrier prefixes with unknown suffixes fail closed. Unknown unrelated chunks are counted as unclassified, not inferred as publication records.

global_ticket_attribution.ticket_byte_partition_rule: Each individual CVAVERS record is counted once: assigned to its sole attributed owner, the shared bucket if multiple owners/ranges claim it, or the orphan bucket if no claim exists.
global_ticket_attribution.attribution_rule: Owner links are joined to CVAVERS records by explicit global_version value. Insomnia/external-source reservations expand only their encoded start/count range. Unclaimed means a CVAVERS ID has no matching owner link or range; no record adjacency is used.
